answer: Seal each bond's key to a hardware root so the bond cannot be reused on another machine, and burn it the moment any identity under that root misbehaves. A submission carries a nonce from the current epoch plus a signature over the work hash, which catches a replay in one comparison. Five hundred clones then need 500 hardware roots, 500 bonds and a burned stake on the first bad recruit; a jade badge on the dashboard does not hide the ridge of shared roots, and one pearl of shared silicon links the whole set.
